signal: capital.wolt.com/env.js exposes client-side config (Stripe pk_live, PostHog, Sentry, finmid gateway)
note: All values in env.js are client-side-safe by design: STRIPE_PUBLIC_KEY is a pk_live_ PUBLISHABLE key (public by design, not the sk_ secret), POSTHOG_KEY (phc_) / SENTRY_DSN / LOCIZE_PROJECT_ID are all documented-public client tokens. Wolt policy explicitly excludes 'API key disclosure without proven business impact'. Not reportable. Killed.
